market_view: Risk-off tilt: VIX 18.8 (+25% in 5 days), chips sold off 9% in a week, and a new 50% US tariff on Canadian goods; oil keeps rising on the escalating US-Iran conflict while gold and uranium stay in downtrends.

oil_gas.catalyst: "Oil prices rise after Trump says Iran will pay for killing U.S. service members" (CNBC, 2026-07-19): US-Iran conflict escalating further, not de-escalating; WTI 82.5 (+15.5% in 5 days), Brent 88.1.
oil_gas.reasoning: Supply-shock storyline is still escalating after the weekend; XOM (+6.1% in 5 days) has moved only about 0.4 times crude, inside the handbook range, so no catch-up edge. Renew the expiring hold for 10 days; Q2 earnings late July add variance. Exit on ceasefire or Hormuz reopening.

gold_miners.catalyst: none (only a NEM Q2 earnings preview piece, and "Genesis Minerals Drops as Investors Reassess Gold Stocks")
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold -8.3% in 20 days, below its 200-day average, dollar and 10-year yield firm. Q2 earnings ahead add variance, no one-sided setup.

chips.catalyst: none for NVDA; "AMD launches Helios ... adding Microsoft as newest buyer" (CNBC) is a competitive negative for the leader, NVIDIA posts are routine product blogs
chips.reasoning: Sector ETF -8.9% in 5 days with rising VIX; no guidance or export-rule catalyst for NVDA, and a new rival rack win at Microsoft. Stay flat.

pharma.catalyst: none ("Retatrutide Dosing: What We Know So Far", Ro, is an explainer, not trial or regulator news)
pharma.reasoning: LLY near highs with no new company-specific news; earnings season adds variance only.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none; the 50% US tariff on Canadian goods (AP News) has an unclear sign for FCX and no direct copper supply headline
copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX -15.5% in 20 days, copper softening, uranium ETF falling; no named catalyst for the leader.

would_change_my_mind: A ceasefire or Hormuz reopening headline (exit XOM); an NVDA guidance or export-rule change; a copper supply outage or China stimulus headline for FCX.

handoff.what_changed: Iran conflict escalated again: CNBC reports Trump saying Iran will pay for killing US service members; WTI 82.5 (+15.5% in 5 days), Brent 88.1, XOM +6.1%. Chips fell about 9% in a week and AMD won Microsoft for its Helios rack; VIX up 25% in 5 days; US imposed 50% tariffs on Canadian goods.

oil_gas.position: long XOM since 2026-07-07, 10 days (renewed 2026-07-20 for 10 more days, ends about 2026-08-03)
oil_gas.why: Iran/Hormuz supply shock still escalating after US service member deaths; no de-escalation seen.

gold_miners.why: Gold bear market with firm dollar and yields; only a NEM Q2 earnings preview.

chips.why: No NVDA catalyst; AMD Helios Microsoft win is a competitive negative and the sector is selling off.

pharma.why: No trial, regulator or guidance news for LLY.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX catalyst; Canada tariff effect on copper unclear; uranium still falling.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day, read this note; exit XOM to flat if the Iran/Hormuz conflict de-escalates (ceasefire, Hormuz reopening) or the renewed horizon (about 2026-08-03) has ended, otherwise re-check its catalyst and the Q2 earnings result; then re-check all five families for a named catalyst in the new headlines.
